title: TrussTutor-Bench: Benchmarking large language models on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection in statics
abstract: arXiv:2610.38917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become a default source of help for students in science and engineering courses. In foundational engineering mechanics courses such as statics, students routinely use these tools to check answers, work through partial solutions, and ask for explanations. Effective tutoring in this setting requires more than a correct final answer. A model must also confirm correct work when a student doubts it, and identify errors in flawed work. Existing benchmarks evaluate LLMs primarily on final-answer accuracy, so it is unclear whether models that can solve mechanics problems also have the other technical capabilities that tutoring depends on. Here we introduce TrussTutor-Bench, a benchmark of 200 verified two-dimensional truss problems paired with automatically generated student solutions, and use it to evaluate thirteen LLMs on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection. translated_title: TrussTutor-Bench：在静力学领域对大型语言模型的解题准确性、谄媚性与错误检测能力进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）已迅速成为理工科课程中学生求助的默认来源。在静力学等基础工程力学课程中，学生经常使用这些工具来核对答案、推演部分解题步骤以及请求解释。在这种情境下，有效的辅导所需要的远不止一个正确的最终答案：当学生怀疑正确解法时，模型必须能够予以确认；而在有缺陷的解法中，模型必须能够识别出错误。现有的基准测试主要从最终答案准确性方面评估LLM，因此尚不清楚能够求解力学问题的模型是否也具备辅导所依赖的其他技术能力。在此，我们推出了TrussTutor-Bench，这是一个包含200道经过验证的二维桁架问题并配有自动生成的学生解答的基准测试，我们用它从解题准确性、谄媚性和错误检测三个方面对十三个大型语言模型进行了评估。基线准确率的范围从……
tldr: 该论文提出了TrussTutor-Bench基准，利用200道经验证的二维桁架题目及其配套的自动生成学生解答，从解题准确性、谄媚性和错误检测三个维度评估了13个大型语言模型，弥补了现有基准仅关注最终答案准确性、无法衡量模型真实辅导能力的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TrussTutor-Bench, a benchmark of 200 verified two-dimensional truss problems paired with automatically generated student solutions, which evaluates thirteen LLMs on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection—addressing the gap left by existing benchmarks that assess only final-answer accuracy rather than the full technical capabilities required for effective tutoring in statics.
